sentences.en: It will churn out only goodness in the long run.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，它只会产出好的结果。

sentences.en: All those who churn the wind believe they can grow.
sentences.zh: 所有那些因焦虑而担忧的人认为自己能够成长。

sentences.en: If you churn goat milk, you'll get sour milk and butter.
sentences.zh: 搅拌羊奶的话，你会得到酸奶和黄油。
